in_arabic.name: Qasumah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Qasumah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'Qasamah' which means 'gracious', 'benevolent', or 'generous'. This name is often given to girls born in the Islamic world as a sign of God's blessings and grace.
